evidence_quotes.O: I managed to get my grubby hands on a Nexus 7 at launch day to play around with it.
evidence_quotes.C: I copied 400 megs of files to the drive in about 8 seconds. That's pretty darn fast- actually faster than the specs say.
evidence_quotes.E: I'll readily admit it- the main reason I got this was to take pictures of myself.
evidence_quotes.A: I got one of these for a friend, someone who I know isn't going to be picky about hardware specs and speed.
evidence_quotes.N: Quite simply, Mac laptops are just a lot less fuss. They don't break down or exhibit weird quirks as often as PC notebooks
